e.title: Claims Processing Hack (Microsoft)
e.summary: 微软 Foundry 理赔处理黑客松模板（34★）：MCP 部署 + 多文档 AI 对比 + GenAIOps 全链路
e.body: Claims Processing with Microsoft Foundry Agents Hackathon（microsoft/claims-processing-hack，34★）是微软官方理赔处理黑客松模板：用 Azure AI Foundry 与 MCP 构建企业级智能理赔系统——对比多种文档 AI 技术（GPT-4.1-mini vision、Mistral Document AI、Azure Document Intelligence）以按成本/精度取舍，涵盖向量化搜索、智能体编排、GenAIOps（持续评测+OpenTelemetry 追踪）与经 Azure API Management 部署 MCP server（可接入 Copilot/Claude Desktop），前端 Streamlit。对 RIAA：agentic 理赔处理的全栈教学——与 [[claims-intake-agent]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]（微软 AF 系列）配套；MCP 部署与 [[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[mcp-chainladder]] 同类。

e.summary_en: Microsoft Foundry claims-processing hackathon template (34★): MCP deployment + multi-document-AI comparison + full GenAIOps lifecycle
e.summary_hk: 微軟 Foundry 理賠處理黑客松模板（34★）：MCP 部署 + 多文檔 AI 對比 + GenAIOps 全鏈路
e.body_en: Claims Processing with Microsoft Foundry Agents Hackathon (microsoft/claims-processing-hack, 34★) is Microsoft's official hackathon template for building an enterprise-grade intelligent claims system with Azure AI Foundry and the Model Context Protocol: it compares multiple document-AI techniques (GPT-4.1-mini vision, Mistral Document AI, Azure Document Intelligence) to choose by cost/accuracy, and covers vectorised search, agent orchestration, the GenAIOps lifecycle (continuous evaluation + OpenTelemetry tracing) and deploying the MCP server through Azure API Management (reachable from Copilot / Claude Desktop), with a Streamlit front end. For RIAA: a full-stack teaching resource for agentic claims processing — pairs with [[claims-intake-agent]] and [[claims-fraud-guardian]] (Microsoft Agent Framework series); the MCP deployment is in the same family as [[insurance-ai-mcp]] and [[mcp-chainladder]].
e.body_hk: Claims Processing with Microsoft Foundry Agents Hackathon（microsoft/claims-processing-hack，34★）是微軟官方理賠處理黑客松模板：用 Azure AI Foundry 與 MCP 構建企業級智能理賠系統——對比多種文檔 AI 技術（GPT-4.1-mini vision、Mistral Document AI、Azure Document Intelligence）以按成本/精度取捨，涵蓋向量化搜索、智能體編排、GenAIOps（持續評測+OpenTelemetry 追蹤）與經 Azure API Management 部署 MCP server（可接入 Copilot/Claude Desktop），前端 Streamlit。對 RIAA：agentic 理賠處理的全棧教學——與 [[claims-intake-agent]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]（微軟 AF 系列）配套；MCP 部署與 [[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[mcp-chainladder]] 同類。
